<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="f">
  <final id="f">
    <transition event="go" target="f"/>
  </final>

notes: a <final> state is atomic and completes its parent when entered; it may contain only <onentry>, <onexit>, and <donedata>
diagnostics.help: change `<final>` to `<state>` if it must react or contain children, or move this element to a non-final state
